subroutine flood(nrow, ncol, g, vis, stk, r0, c0, conn, sz)
integer nrow, ncol, r0, c0, conn, sz
integer g(256,256), vis(256,256), stk(65536,2)
integer sp, tr, tc, nr, nc, dr, dc
sp = 1
stk(1,1) = r0
stk(1,2) = c0
vis(r0,c0) = 1
sz = 0
while (sp > 0) {
  tr = stk(sp,1)
  tc = stk(sp,2)
  sp = sp - 1
  sz = sz + 1
  for (dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr = dr + 1)
    for (dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc = dc + 1) {
      if (dr == 0 & dc == 0) next
      if (conn == 4 & dr != 0 & dc != 0) next
      nr = tr + dr
      nc = tc + dc
      if (nr < 1 | nr > nrow | nc < 1 | nc > ncol) next
      if (g(nr,nc) == 2 & vis(nr,nc) == 0) {
        vis(nr,nc) = 1
        sp = sp + 1
        stk(sp,1) = nr
        stk(sp,2) = nc
      }
    }
}
end

integer nrow, ncol, i, j, nf, nd, nring, best, ncl, sz, x, y
integer g(256,256), vis(256,256), stk(65536,2)
integer*8 bigd2, dd2, lhs, rhs
read(5,*) nrow, ncol
do i = 1, nrow
  read(5,*) (g(i,j), j = 1, ncol)
nf = 0
nd = 0
do i = 1, nrow
  do j = 1, ncol {
    if (g(i,j) == 2) nf = nf + 1
    if (g(i,j) >= 1) nd = nd + 1
  }
do i = 1, 256
  do j = 1, 256
    vis(i,j) = 0
best = 0
do i = 1, nrow
  do j = 1, ncol
    if (g(i,j) == 2 & vis(i,j) == 0) {
      call flood(nrow, ncol, g, vis, stk, i, j, 4, sz)
      if (sz > best) best = sz
    }
do i = 1, 256
  do j = 1, 256
    vis(i,j) = 0
ncl = 0
do i = 1, nrow
  do j = 1, ncol
    if (g(i,j) == 2 & vis(i,j) == 0) {
      call flood(nrow, ncol, g, vis, stk, i, j, 8, sz)
      if (sz >= 5) ncl = ncl + 1
    }
bigd2 = 0
do i = 1, nrow
  do j = 1, ncol
    if (g(i,j) >= 1) {
      x = 2*i - nrow - 1
      y = 2*j - ncol - 1
      dd2 = x*x + y*y
      if (dd2 > bigd2) bigd2 = dd2
    }
nring = 0
do i = 1, nrow
  do j = 1, ncol
    if (g(i,j) == 2) {
      x = 2*i - nrow - 1
      y = 2*j - ncol - 1
      dd2 = x*x + y*y
      lhs = 4900 * bigd2
      rhs = 10000 * dd2
      if (lhs <= rhs) nring = nring + 1
    }
write(6,*) nf, best, ncl, nd, nring
end
